content.short: Block Consult is a Swiss-based consulting firm that creates holistic Web3 ideas.
content.description: Block Consult bridges traditional business models with blockchain opportunities, helping established companies navigate the challenges that arise when exploring crypto-enabled solutions and pathways to adoption. The firm also mentors web3-native startups from idea through to scale, providing strategic guidance, technical feasibility input, and market execution support. With this deep, practical expertise, organizations can integrate into a decentralized future while staying competitive and relevant in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

resources.title: DAO Governance That Actually Works
resources.tldr: One token one vote collapses in practice, and this covers the structures teams reach for instead. Grounded in mechanisms rather than governance theory.

resources.title: Token Compliance: MiCA, the Howey Test, and Launching Safely
resources.tldr: Two regimes with different questions, applied to the same token. Structured around not walking into a securities problem rather than around the law.

resources.title: Real-World Assets Onchain: Tokenising Beyond the Hype
resources.tldr: Separates what is genuinely live in tokenised finance from what is still being promised, then sits with the custody and legal questions nobody has closed.
